identity.title: Compose tangram images
identity.subject: Maths
identity.unit_title: Recognise, compose, decompose and manipulate 2D and 3D shapes

keywords.description: An ancient Chinese puzzle of seven pieces that make a square.
A 2D shape with four equal sides.

key_learning_points.keyLearningPoint: Individual tangram pieces can be discussed and compared.
Some tangram pieces are the same size when laid directly on top of each other.
Tangram pictures, using two or more pieces, can be created and described.
Tangram pieces can be laid directly onto diagrams to create pictures

learning.pupil_lesson_outcome: I can compare and discuss individual tangram pieces and make my own pictures.

misconceptions.response: Lay the tangram pieces on top of each other to physically explore and compare the size of each piece.
misconceptions.misconception: Children might not notice that the two small and two large triangles are the same size.
